PAGE_NOT_FOUND_DESCRIPTION: This address does not belong to the Platform Console. Use the navigation to return to Operations Inbox.
UNEXPECTED_TITLE: The Platform Console could not show this page
UNEXPECTED_DESCRIPTION: The page did not finish loading. Refresh and try again; if the problem continues, keep the current address for investigation.
PLATFORM_SETUP_STATE_UNAVAILABLE: The Platform Console could not check setup state
PLATFORM_SETUP_STATE_UNAVAILABLE_RECOVER: Check the Platform API and try again. The Console did not assume setup was complete.
PLATFORM_SETUP_FAILED: The Instance Owner could not be created
PLATFORM_SETUP_FAILED_RECOVERY: Review the account details and try again. No successful setup was recorded.
INSTANCE_ALREADY_INITIALIZED_RECOVERY: Continue to Platform sign-in with the existing Instance Owner account.
INSTANCE_SETUP_REPAIR_REQUIRED_RECOVERY: Ask the deployment operator to repair the setup records, then check the setup state again.
EMAIL_EXISTS: This email is already in use
EMAIL_EXISTS_RECOVERY: Use a different email address for the first Instance Owner.
USERNAME_EXISTS: This account name is already in use
USERNAME_EXISTS_RECOVERY: Choose a different account name for the first Instance Owner.
PLATFORM_INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Your sign-in details could not be verified
PLATFORM_INVALID_CREDENTIALS_RECOVERY: Check your email or username and password, then try again.
PLATFORM_ACCESS_REQUIRED: This account cannot access the Platform Console
PLATFORM_ACCESS_REQUIRED_RECOVERY: Return to the product or contact the Instance Owner if you expected Platform access.
PLATFORM_IDENTITY_CHANGED_RECOVERY: Start sign-in again to use the current account state.
PLATFORM_AUTH_FLOW_INVALID: This sign-in has expired or was already used
PLATFORM_AUTH_FLOW_INVALID_RECOVERY: Start sign-in again and complete security verification without reusing this attempt.
PLATFORM_NETWORK_ERROR: The Platform Console could not reach the Platform API
PLATFORM_NETWORK_ERROR_RECOVERY: Check your connection and try again. No successful verification was recorded.
PLATFORM_SESSION_EXPIRED_RECOVERY: Complete Platform security verification to sign in again.
PLATFORM_SESSION_REVOKED: Your Platform access on this device ended
PLATFORM_SESSION_REVOKED_RECOVERY: Sign in again. If access was removed, the Platform API will keep it blocked.
SECURITY_KEY_REQUIRED: A security key or passkey is required
SECURITY_KEY_REQUIRED_RECOVERY: Add or recover a security key or passkey before continuing.
SECURITY_KEY_UNAVAILABLE_RECOVERY: The Platform cannot complete this required verification. Contact the deployment operator; no access was granted.
SECURITY_KEY_CANCELLED_RECOVERY: Keep this page open and try the security key or passkey again.
PLATFORM_CODE_INVALID: The verification code was not accepted
PLATFORM_CODE_INVALID_RECOVERY: Enter the current code from your authenticator app and try again.
PLATFORM_AUTH_UNEXPECTED_RECOVERY: Start sign-in again. The Console did not treat this attempt as successful.
OPERATIONAL_SIGNAL_TRIAGE_REVISION_CONFL: Another operator changed this item's work status first. Your change was not applied.
OPERATIONAL_SIGNAL_SOURCE_RESOLVED: The owning service already resolved this problem. Work coordination is now read-only.
OPERATIONAL_SIGNAL_ALREADY_CLAIMED: Another operator already claimed this item. Your change was not applied.
OPERATIONAL_SIGNAL_ASSIGNEE_REQUIRED: Assign this item before marking work in progress.
OPERATIONAL_SIGNAL_ASSIGNEE_INELIGIBLE: The selected operator is no longer available for assignment. Your change was not applied.
OPERATIONAL_SIGNAL_REMINDER_INVALID: Choose a future reminder time and provide a reason. Your change was not applied.
OPERATIONAL_SIGNAL_NOT_FOUND: This operational work item no longer exists or is not available to you.
PLATFORM_OPERATIONS_REQUEST_FAILED: The Platform API could not complete this request. Nothing was changed.
PLATFORM_OPERATIONS_RESPONSE_INVALID: The Platform API returned an invalid response. Nothing was changed.
